0022600132.text: The Hawks (2-2, second in the Southeast and one game back, 7th in the East) host the Miami Heat (0-4, fifth in the Southeast and three games back, 15th in the East) in Atlanta's fifth game of the season, with Atlanta on a two-game losing streak and 0-1 at home. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and Atlanta lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, including a 143-117 loss in Miami on April 12, 2026. Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) are out for Atlanta, Aaron Wiggins (knee bruise) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, and Miami's Pelle Larsson (ankle sprain) and Simone Fontecchio (illness) are both day-to-day and game-time decisions.
